units.english: The <npc> has gone missing during a tech retrieval mission in the Ember Waste. Find them and help them return to <destination>.

units.italian: Il tuo comunicatore ti notifica un'assegnazione di risorse di <payment>, insieme a un breve biglietto di ringraziamento.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Rescue 2B|As you enter the system, your sensors pick up a lot of debris. Further analysis confirms your worst fears. The <npc> has been destroyed. You frantically spend the next few hours searching for survivors, your hope sinking with every passing minute.|553|0
units.english: As you enter the system, your sensors pick up a lot of debris. Further analysis confirms your worst fears. The <npc> has been destroyed. You frantically spend the next few hours searching for survivors, your hope sinking with every passing minute.
units.italian: Appena entri nel sistema, i sensori rilevano molti detriti. Un'analisi più attenta conferma i tuoi peggiori timori. La <npc> è stata distrutta. Passi le ore successive a cercare affannosamente superstiti, con la speranza che affonda minuto dopo minuto.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Rescue 2B|You land, and with a heavy heart, report that the <npc> was lost with all hands. The Remnant are saddened at the news, but thank you regardless and hand off your resource allocation of <payment>.|558|0
units.english: You land, and with a heavy heart, report that the <npc> was lost with all hands. The Remnant are saddened at the news, but thank you regardless and hand off your resource allocation of <payment>.
units.italian: Atterri e, con il cuore pesante, riferisci che la <npc> è andata perduta con tutto l'equipaggio. I Remnant si rattristano alla notizia, ma ti ringraziano comunque e ti consegnano l'assegnazione di risorse di <payment>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Rescue 4|description|645|0
units.english: A distress signal has been received from the <npc> in the Graveyard. Follow the telemetry data to find them, and help return them safely to <destination>.
units.italian: Abbiamo ricevuto un segnale di soccorso dalla <npc> nel Cimitero. Segui i dati di telemetria per trovarla e aiutala a tornare sana e salva su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Rescue 4|Upon landing, the captain of the <npc> meets you at your ship to thank you personally for rescuing them from the Graveyard, leaving you with a heartfelt sentence: "May the Embers burn bright for you."|670|0
units.english: Upon landing, the captain of the <npc> meets you at your ship to thank you personally for rescuing them from the Graveyard, leaving you with a heartfelt sentence: "May the Embers burn bright for you."
units.italian: Quando atterri, il capitano della <npc> ti aspetta alla tua nave per ringraziarti di persona di averla tratta in salvo dal Cimitero, e ti congeda con una frase sentita: "Che le Braci ardano luminose per te."
